title: REQ · Pure preload planner and fallback resolver validate scene asset refs
summary: Engine planner lists needed assets, reports unknown refs and resolves a fallback key
description: A Phaser-free module game/src/engine/preload.ts builds a deduplicated load list from scene object assets and dust effect assets using the manifest, reports unknown ids via the existing checkAssetRefs, and resolves any key to the fallback id when it is unknown or failed to load.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects sharing one asset id, When planPreload runs, Then that asset appears once in the entries
Given a ref not in the manifest, When planPreload runs, Then issues contains one entry naming the ref and entries omit it
Given a key not in the loaded set, When resolveTextureKey runs, Then it returns FALLBACK_ASSET_ID
technical_constraints: Reuse checkAssetRefs and FALLBACK_ASSET_ID from manifestLoader.ts, do not duplicate them
definition_of_done: planPreload and resolveTextureKey exported and typed
